content.short: Mantle Rewards Station is the official rewards and incentive hub where users earn MNT and ecosystem tokens for participating in Mantle Network.
content.description: The Mantle Rewards Station is the official incentive distribution platform of the Mantle Network, designed to reward users who actively participate in the ecosystem's growth. Users can earn MNT tokens and other ecosystem rewards by providing liquidity, using DeFi protocols, bridging assets, and completing various ecosystem activities. The platform tracks user contributions across the Mantle ecosystem and distributes rewards proportionally through a transparent, on-chain mechanism managed by the Mantle team.
